label: VERIFIED
extraction: Cursor APIs Overview: TypeScript SDK (run Cursor agents from TypeScript, one interface for local/cloud runtimes, all users), Python SDK (sync/async clients for local/cloud runtimes, all users), SDK Bridge (build agent SDKs in other languages on open bridge protocol and standalone binaries, all users). Cloud Agents API and SDKs run Cursor agent workflows (workspace context, tools, commands, edits) - NOT standalone model-inference or chat-completions API. Cursor Router selects models for agent runs when using Auto/auto-smart.
